note: Human-editable housing search filters (single flat object). Every key is optional: null/absent = no restriction; [] for a multi-value filter also means no restriction. These are only shipped starting values, not code-level defaults — removing a key (or setting it to null) produces a `None` field on FilterConfig with no fallback. Ranged filters take `_min`/`_max` pairs where null leaves that side open. Multi-value filters take a JSON array of strings; `construction_type` also accepts a bare string (legacy `existing`/`new` are mapped to `resale`/`newly_built`). `garden` (bool) is a legacy shorthand for `exterior_space_type` containing "garden"; `garden_size_min` applies only when a garden is selected. Encoding rules are documented in Architecture.md 'Phase 2 — Configurable Search Filters'.
_comment: Valid values for the multi-value filters (each accepts a JSON array of strings, e.g. ["apartment", "house"]; null or [] = no restriction): object_type=["apartment", "house"]; construction_type=["newly_built", "resale"] (legacy "new"/"existing" accepted and mapped); energy_labels=["A+++++", "A++++", "A+++", "A++", "A+", "A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G"] (ordered; NOTE the loader does not vocabulary-enforce this field — any non-empty label string is accepted); exterior_space_type=["balcony", "terrace", "garden"]; exterior_space_garden_orientation=["north", "east", "south", "west"]; zoning=["residential", "recreational"]; parking_facility=["on_private_property", "on_enclosed_property", "public_parking", "paid_parking", "parking_garage", "parking_permits"]; garage_type=["lean_to", "lock_up", "garage_and_carport", "built_in", "underground", "basement", "detached", "garage_possible", "carport", "parking_space", "all_garages"]; accessibility=["lift", "single_storey", "accessible_for_the_disabled", "accessible_for_the_elderly", "adapted_home", "ground_floor"]; amenities=["renewable_energy", "central_heating_boiler", "swimming_pool", "bathtub", "fireplace", "fixer_upper", "double_occupancy"].
